AND UPPER(X.BTOA_USER_DEPT) LIKE UPPER('%'||#{st_btoa_user_dept_name}||'%')
ORDER BY X.BUYER, X.QUOTATION_NO, X.QUOTATION_SEQ, X.REVISION ) Y
ORDER BY Y.QUOTATION_NO DESC
ORDER BY Y.QUOTATION_NO ASC
ORDER BY Y.BTOA_DATE DESC
ORDER BY Y.BTOA_DATE ASC
ORDER BY Y.BTOA_END_DATE DESC
ORDER BY Y.BTOA_END_DATE ASC
ORDER BY Y.MAKER_NAME DESC
ORDER BY Y.MAKER_NAME ASC
ORDER BY Y.BTOA_USER_DEPT DESC
ORDER BY Y.BTOA_USER_DEPT ASC
